purpose: One isolated development retrain to measure native scene-linear HDR Ours utility against unchanged official V2E events. Not a ranking or formal test.

ours_input_endpoint.units: scene-linear renderer radiance; values are not display grayscale or 8-bit DN
ours_input_endpoint.conversion: Genesis frozen plugin physical_log response; natural logarithm of positive radiance with the plugin radiance floor
ours_input_endpoint.noise_filters_refractory: disabled for this ideal deterministic development profile
ours_input_endpoint.geometry_inputs: cached depth, segmentation, camera pose, object pose used internally for motion/disocclusion reconstruction only

v2e_input_endpoint.source: reuse exact official V2E + SuperSloMo event archives from the paired small9 development batch
v2e_input_endpoint.boundary: V2E retains its complete display-video input, official SuperSloMo interpolation, and its already-frozen ideal response overlay; no events are deleted or post-filtered

training.checkpoint_selection: same validation loss and early-stopping rule for both methods

evaluation.reference: same existing nine-episode 2 kHz Direct-HDR reference events and exact same pre-contact poll timestamps for both checkpoints
evaluation.status: development only; episodes were already inspected and are not a held-out test set
